signals.summary: Harvey raised $550M at a $15.5B valuation, co-led by Diffusion and Lightspeed. This follows a $200M round at $11B in March 2026 and an $8B valuation in December 2025.
Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan invested US$50M in Harvey, and Harvey announced a deeper commitment to Canada.

Co-founder Winston Weinberg said ARR has passed $400M, up from about $190M in January. Harvey says it has 3,000+ customer organizations, 200,000+ lawyers, and 80% of the Am Law 100. The ARR figure was reported widely but was not in Harvey's own funding announcement.
Harvey is opening a Boston office. It will support existing customers (Ropes & Gray, Mintz, DraftKings, Toast and others) and house sales staff. COO Katie Burke was quoted.
CEO Winston Weinberg told Nikkei that Harvey will open a Japan office in 2027 and target major Japanese law firms and corporate legal departments.
Harvey chose London to lead its pro bono push (City A.M. headline).

Harvey hired 22 Am Law 200 lawyers in six months, more than Anthropic, OpenAI and Legora combined. Many went into ~$220K 'legal engineer' roles. Harvey and Legora together have nearly 600 open roles. Crustdata lists about 1,795 Harvey employees, up 129% year over year.
Harvey published an engineering post on its Connector Library. Users have 100,000+ connections to external tools, with a policy engine governing what agents can access.
Harvey integrated PacerPro docket data into litigation workflows. Its implementation of DeepJudge's Agent Handoff Protocol is entering beta. Both items come from an aggregator and have no firm dates.

answer.notes: The funding announcement date is inconsistent across sources. Okara, HokAI and Medium point to September 9, 2026, with a Medium piece dated Sept 20. SaaSRise says Oct 1, and it looks less reliable. I used Sept 9. Funding and ARR details come mostly from secondary sources, not a primary Harvey press release. The PacerPro and DeepJudge items are undated, so check them before citing. Competitive context from one newsletter: Legora raised $600M at $5.6B and is reportedly in talks at about $10B. Anthropic, Google and OpenAI have each shipped legal products. Earlier 2026 events, outside the 90-day window, include the Hexus acquisition and the HSBC and SCC Online partnerships in January. I did not find any leadership changes or layoffs.
